A '''Scenes of Crimes Officer''', also known as a '''SOCO''', was a member of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force's]] [[Forensics Unit]].

==History==
SOCOs were charged with collecting and analyzing evidence at crime scenes.
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] most SOCOs were [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]].
In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] forensics units were sent to collect and analyze data at the bombing of [[The Elite (hotel)|The Elite Hotel]].
